user.title: Network Devices
user.description: Home Assistant probes these subnets and lists every device that answers, with its hostname, MAC address, vendor and IP address. Only networks Home Assistant is connected to can be scanned (devices on other VLANs are not visible). Your networks are pre-filled.

error.invalid_subnet: Enter subnets like 192.168.1.0/24, separated by commas (4096 addresses at most).
error.not_local: Home Assistant isn't connected to {remote}, so it can't see devices there (MAC addresses don't cross routers). Home Assistant is on: {local}.
error.no_devices: No devices answered. If Home Assistant runs in Docker, it needs network_mode: host.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Network Devices is already set up. Use Configure to change the subnets.
